name: HCDA Citizen Advisory Committee Regular Meeting Agenda (PDF)
agenda_text:
AGENDA
HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT CITIZEN ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 3, 2019 AT 7:00 P.M.
  REGULAR MEETING
  ALHAMBRA CITY HALL
  111 S. FIRST ST.
  ALHAMBRA, CA 91801

1. ROLL CALL:
  Bill Vallejos, Chair  Mark Lee, Vice Chair
  Steven Cosci  Carolyn Ortiz
  Octavio Casado  Marc Tousignant
  Eric Sunada  Conchita Bañuelos
  Marcos Sayon

2. MINUTES – Approval of the minutes for the Regular Meetings of July 2, 2019 and April 2,
  2019.

3. PROGRESS REPORTS
  Attached for the Committee’s review are copies of the Progress Reports for those programs
  utilizing Community Development Block Grant and HOME Funds. All figures indicate the
  progress made and services rendered to date for FY 2019-2020.
   Community Services - Case Management
   77 Case Management clients were served.
   6 Volunteer Hours of assistance were donated to the program.
   Development Services - Code Enforcement
   The Code Enforcement Division investigated a total of 88 complaints.
   56 were in areas identified as in low- to moderate-income areas.
   Code Enforcement staff referred 15 to the Housing Department programs.
   Development Services - Fair Housing
   The Housing Rights Center served approx. 10 clients.
   A variety of issues were discussed, including: evictions, security deposits, rent
  increases, repairs, contract questions, etc.
   Development Services - Housing Programs
   First-Time Home Buyer - HOME: 12 searching for a home, 0 escrows closed.
   HOME Major Rehabilitation: 1 in process, 0 completed.
   CDBG Minor Rehabilitation: 1 in process, 0 completed.

  Recommended Action
  Receive and file these informational reports.

4. 2018-2019 CONSOLIDATED ANNUAL PERFORMANCE AND EVALUATION
  REPORT (CAPER)
  Each year, the City of Alhambra is required by the Department of Housing and Urban
  Development to prepare a “Performance Report.” This report covers the previous fiscal
  year’s activities and expenditures. The report highlights the accomplishments of the year and
  the funds expended for each specific program.

  The City of Alhambra has been successful in meeting and in some cases exceeding its
  projected performance goals and objectives as defined in the Consolidated and Annual
  Action Plans. The CAPER provides for measurable performance against stated performance
   objectives. Impacts of planned program performance have been exceeded in Case
  Management and Housing Rehabilitation programs.

  Staff will review this report with the committee. A copy of the full report will be available
  for public review and comment September 4 through September 19, 2019, and will be
  noticed in the Pasadena Star News, La Opinion, and World News. The report is due to HUD
  no later than September 28, 2019.
  Recommended Action
  Recommend approval to the City Council the Consolidated Annual Performance &
  Evaluation Report for 2018-2019 and direct staff to submit this report to HUD following the
  public review period.

5. COMMENTS FROM THE AUDIENCE
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain
  to the business of the HCDA Citizen Advisory Committee. Public comments pertaining to
  the HCDA Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to five
  (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee’s secretary.

6. COMMENTS AND CONCERNS FROM THE COMMITTEE
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the HCDA Citizen Advisory Committee.

7. ADJOURNMENT

 Copies of the staff report or other written documentation relating to each item of business described herein
 above are on file in the office of Management Services, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra,
 CA, and are available for public inspection during regular office hours: 8:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M., Monday
 through Friday.
 Should any person have a question concerning any of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described
 herein, he or she may contact Mr. Julio Donayre, Committee Secretary, either in person, at the Management
 Services Department located at City Hall, or call via telephone at (626) 570-3252, during regular business
 hours.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: If you require special assistance to participate in any City meeting, please
 contact the City Clerk's Office (626) 570-5090. Notification of at least 72 hours prior to the meeting will
 enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting.
